- All verify-phase shards also have `depends_on: []`, meaning they can all run in parallel in wave 1 alongside the map-phase shards
- The reduce-final task depends on ALL 30 previous tasks (15 map + 15 verify)

Let me start by spawning all the map and verify sub-agents in parallel (wave 1), then wait for all to complete before spawning the reducer.
